data.narrative:
GRU is a Space & Aerospace frontier-tech company at an undisclosed stage, founded by Skyler Chan. The addressable comp universe consists of 5 public-market peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private companies, including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Peer-median triangulation is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the Space & Aerospace sector. Of 14 same-sector peers identified, none satisfied the narrow filters required (minimum 3 datapoints at equivalent stage or valuation tier). Public-comp anchoring cannot be executed because GRU's revenue is not on file; while the Space & Aerospace public-market cohort trades at a median 24.6x price-to-sales across 6 tickers, applying this multiple without disclosed target revenue would be speculative.

The absence of sufficient narrow-stage peers and the lack of GRU's revenue disclosure preclude quantitative triangulation at this time. A defensible valuation would require either (1) disclosure of GRU's historical or projected revenue, enabling public-multiple application, or (2) identification of at least three private-market transactions in an equivalent stage and business model within Space & Aerospace. Until those data become available, valuation analysis must remain suspended.
